highResTransform.description: large_default is already the highest resolution available (1300×1768px). No zoom_default exists on this store. To get listing thumbnails instead use listing_category_default (300×408px). No find/replace needed — just use the large_default URL as-is.

notes: Platform is PrestaShop (confirmed via global `prestashop` JS object and body class structure). Color variant strategy is SEPARATE-URL: each color is a distinct product page with its own URL slug (e.g. -cassiopee-black-5012.html vs -cassiopee-electric-pink-6227.html). Clicking a color swatch triggers a full page navigation — no in-place AJAX image swap. All product images (3–4 per color) are stacked vertically in .images-container and fully loaded on page load — no thumbnails, carousels, or lazy loading needed to expose them. No lightbox opens on image click despite fancybox.js being loaded. No next/prev or zoom buttons are present in the product image area. The size selector is a <select#group_25> dropdown and does NOT affect images. On listing pages, color swatches are rendered as radio inputs inside .plist_attribute_images and link to separate color URLs via <a> tags wrapping the inputs. Pagination is standard numbered with <a rel='next'>. Google reCAPTCHA is present site-wide (mainly for forms, not browsing).
